query_scope: all recorded ordinary collection queries with b=0 from the twenty frozen jobs; no generated or repeated worker queries
base_scope: independently verified geometric worker base, before cofactor projection and orbit folding
oracle: enumerate all unordered base-point pairs, index their exact group sum, then subtract each third base point from the query; independently re-add a found triple
timeout_policy: no report implies unknown query count and unknown oracle yield, never zero
decision: count exact relation existence, observed witness, and solvable-but-bounded-incomplete queries for every report; retain all timeouts; do not rank complete IC pipelines or infer speedup
stop: analyze every frozen report once; fail closed on any source, fixture, query, group, worker, or audit mismatch; no worker dispatch or new target
